title: PFN-Syn: Generating Synthetic Tabular Data with Prior-Data Fitted Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.28440v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Synthetic tabular data can help enable data sharing and model development in privacy-sensitive domains, but existing generators often require dataset-specific training and substantial computation. We introduce PFN-Syn, a training-free framework for synthetic tabular data generation based on prior-data fitted networks. We evaluate PFN-Syn against training-based generators on eight binary classification datasets. PFN-Syn achieves the highest average downstream utility among evaluated synthetic generators, with higher generation throughput than training-based baselines, while maintaining competitive distributional similarity and distance-to-closest-record privacy behavior. Our results suggest that tabular foundation models can serve as useful building blocks for practical synthetic tabular data generation.

translated_title: PFN-Syn：使用先验数据拟合网络生成合成表格数据
translated_abstract: 合成表格数据可以帮助在隐私敏感领域实现数据共享和模型开发，但现有的生成器通常需要针对特定数据集的训练和大量计算。我们提出了PFN-Syn，一个基于先验数据拟合网络的无需训练的合成表格数据生成框架。我们在八个二分类数据集上将PFN-Syn与基于训练的生成器进行了评估。PFN-Syn在所评估的合成数据生成器中实现了最高的平均下游效用，且生成吞吐量高于基于训练的基线方法，同时保持了具有竞争力的分布相似性和最近记录距离隐私表现。我们的结果表明，表格基础模型可以作为实用合成表格数据生成的有用构建模块。
tldr: PFN-Syn是一个基于先验数据拟合网络的无训练合成表格数据生成框架，在八个二分类数据集上实现了最高的平均下游效用和更高的生成吞吐量，同时保持了具有竞争力的分布相似性和隐私表现，表明表格基础模型可用于实用化合成数据生成。
en_tdlr: PFN-Syn is a training-free framework for synthetic tabular data generation based on prior-data fitted networks, achieving the highest average downstream utility and higher generation throughput on eight binary classification datasets while maintaining competitive distributional similarity and privacy behavior, showing that tabular foundation models can serve as practical building blocks for synthetic data generation.
